title: S1122 (2019 Regular): Licenses to Carry Concealed Weapons or Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-02-18; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2019/1122/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 1915642))

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): Such licenses shall be valid throughout the state for a period of 4 years after the date of issuance. Any person in compliance with the terms of such license may carry a concealed weapon or concealed firearm notwithstanding s. 790.01. The licensee must carry the license, together with valid identification, at all times in which the licensee is in actual possession of a concealed weapon or firearm and must display both the license and proper identification upon demand by a law enforcement officer. Violations of this subsection shall constitute a noncriminal violation with a penalty of $25, payable to the clerk of the court.
Section 1 (s. 790.06(2)(h), F.S.): b. Persons who complete an instructional course pursuant to sub-sub-subparagraph a.(I), sub-sub-subparagraph a.(II), sub sub-subparagraph a.(III), or sub-sub-subparagraph a.(V) shall demonstrate their proficiency safely handling and discharging a firearm through the completion of the following course of fire proficiency demonstration with a minimum score of 70 percent: The course of fire proficiency demonstration must be completed using live ammunition.
